blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is increasingly applied to multilingual tasks, yet prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Role Conditioning are recommended based solely on English benchmarks. Whether their effectiveness transfers across judge models and languages remains unknown: prompt-sensitivity studies are largely English-centric, while existing multilingual judge studies fix the prompt template. In this work, we address this gap by measuring this interaction through a benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, 27 languages, and 4 tasks across 13 datasets, yielding over 1M pointwise scores on gold-reference outputs, validated against human judgments. We find that prompting strategies are not transferable: the choice of the judge model dominates the choice of prompting strategy, strategy effects reverse direction across judges, and stability degrades in low-resource languages, where these effects are concealed by aggregate reporting. These findings show that prompting effects in multilingual evaluation are conditioned on the judge, task, and language. Consequently, prompting strategies should be validated for the intended evaluation setting, and cross-study comparisons should account for both judge and prompt configuration.
blocks.zh: 以法官身份进行的LLM评价越来越多地应用于多种语文任务,但诸如 " 思考链 " 和 " 作用条件 " 等推动性战略完全根据英文基准提出。 其效力在法官模型和语言之间的转移是否仍然未知:即时敏感性研究主要是以英语为中心的,而现有的多语种法官研究则固定了即时模板. 在这项工作中,我们通过衡量这种互动,通过9项激励战略、4名公开量级法官、27种语言和13个数据集的4项任务的基准,解决了这一差距,根据人类的判断,在黄金参考产出上得出了超过1M点的分数。 我们发现,促动战略是不可转移的:选择法官模式主导了促动战略的选择,战略影响在法官中间反向,稳定以低资源语言下降,而综合报告掩盖了这些影响。 这些调查结果表明,多语种评价的促进效果取决于法官、任务和语言。 因此,应该为预期的评价环境验证激励战略,相互学习比较应该既考虑到法官,也考虑到迅速的配置。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multilingual evaluation of generated text relies on reference-based metrics such as BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) and ROUGE ( Lin, 2004 ) , and on learned metrics such as BLEURT ( Sellam et al., 2020 ) and COMET ( Rei et al., 2020 ) .
These metrics require human-annotated references in the target language.
Such references are unavailable for most languages and costly to produce at scale.
Recent work therefore employs LLMs as evaluators, a paradigm known as LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2024b ; Gu et al., 2024a ) .
A prompt template specifies a role, an evaluation rubric, and an output format, and the judge applies the rubric criteria directly rather than scoring against a reference, which extends evaluation to languages without annotated evaluation data.
blocks.zh:
对生成文本的多语种评价依赖于基准计量,如BLEU(Papineni等人,2002年)和ROUGE(Lin,2004年),以及BLEURT(Sellam等人,2020年)和COMET(Rei等人,2020年)等学习到的计量。
这些衡量标准需要用目标语言作人说明的参考。
大多数语文都无法提供这种参考材料,而且制作成本很高。
因此,最近的工作雇用LLMs担任评价员,这个范式称为LLM-as-a-judge(郑等,2023;顾等,2024b;顾等,2024a).
即时模板指定了角色,评价标题,以及产出格式,法官直接应用了标题标准,而不是比照参考标准打分,参考标准将评价扩展到没有附加说明的评价数据的语言.

blocks.en:
A reliable multilingual judge should be language-invariant: its scores should reflect the quality of the evaluated output and not the language of that output. Fu and Liu (2025a) score parallel data in 25 languages and report a mean Fleiss’ κ \kappa of approximately 0.3 0.3 , with lower agreement on low-resource languages.
Neither multilingual pretraining nor increased model scale improves this consistency.
This instability is distinct from the generation-quality gaps that performance benchmarks report for low-resource languages ( Ojo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) : generation capability in a language does not predict evaluation reliability in that language.
The judge model and the prompting strategy remain the configurable components of the evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh:
可靠的多语种法官应当是语言不变量的法官:其分数应反映评价产出的质量,而不是该产出的语言。 Fu和Liu(2025a)用25种语言获得平行数据,
多语种预训或增加的模型规模都没有改善这种一致性。
这种不稳定性不同于低资源语言业绩基准报告的生成质量差距(Ojo等,2025;Li等,2025a):一种语言的生成能力无法预测该语言的评价可靠性。
法官模式和激励战略仍然是评价程序的组成部分。

blocks.en:
Chain-of-thought ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , few-shot exemplars, self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and role conditioning ( Salewski et al., 2023 ) were developed for task solving and later carried over to judging.
Studies of judge prompt sensitivity perturb the paraphrasing or format of one template in English rather than comparing distinct strategies ( Sclar et al., 2024 ; Bellibatlu et al., 2026 ) . Fernandes et al. (2023) evaluate in-context prompting for MT quality estimation across several PaLM-2 sizes and language pairs, within a single model family.
MM-Eval ( Son et al., 2024 ) scales meta-evaluation to more languages and M-Prometheus ( Pombal et al., 2025 ) trains multilingual judges, and neither varies the prompting strategy. Chung and Freienthal (2026) show that judge-induced system rankings shift across three related European languages, attributing the instability to the judge’s internal language representation rather than to prompt or judge choice, in a setting limited to commercial judges and closely related languages.
Whether these findings extend to open-weight judges, lower-resource languages, and different prompting strategies remains untested. We ask: Does the effect of a prompting strategy on judge scores depend on the judge model applying it and on the resource level of the language evaluated?
blocks.zh:
思考链(Wei等,2022年),几发取出实例,自相矛盾(Wang等,2023年),角色设定(Salewski等,2023年)是为任务解决而开发的,后被结转到判断.
对法官进行的研究使一个模板的英文解释性或格式受到干扰,而不是比较不同的战略(Sclar等人,2024;Bellibatlu等人,2026)。 Fernandes等人(2023年)在一个单一的模型家庭内,对若干个PALM-2大小和语言对等的MT质量估计进行内文评价。
MM-Eval(Son等,2024年)对更多语言进行元评价,M-Prometheus(Pombal等,2025年)对多语言法官进行培训,两者都不改变提示策略. Chung和Freienthal(2026年)表明,法官引起的系统排名在三种相关的欧洲语言之间发生转变,将不稳定归咎于法官的内部语言代表性,而不是在仅限于商业法官和密切相关语言的情况下作出迅速或法官选择。
这些结论是否延伸至开放量级法官、资源较少的语言以及不同的激励战略,仍然没有经过测试。 我们问:促进策略对法官分数的影响是否取决于运用这一策略的法官模式以及所评价语言的资源水平?

blocks.en:
We benchmark 9 prompting strategies across 4 open-weight judges (Aya Expanse 32B, Gemma 3 27B, Qwen2.5 32B, Qwen2.5 72B), 27 languages, and 4 tasks (machine translation, summarisation, question answering, mathematical reasoning) over 13 datasets, yielding 1.07M pointwise judge scores.
The strategies partition into two groups.
Language-invariant strategies, such as chain-of-thought and few-shot exemplars, hold the prompt language constant.
Language-varying strategies, such as target-language and cross-lingual prompting, vary the prompt language relative to the evaluated content.
The 27 languages span four resource tiers, so resource level varies alongside judge and strategy.
Following Fu and Liu (2025a) , we score gold-reference outputs pointwise.
Holding generation quality fixed, attribute score variance to judge configuration rather than to the evaluated content.
A task-specific rubric with a holistic 1–5 rating scores each judge, strategy, and language combination (Section 3 ).

27种语言跨越了四个资源层次,因此资源水平与法官和战略不同。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. C1. We benchmark prompting-strategy transfer for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation across 9 strategies, 4 judges, 27 languages, 4 tasks, and 13 datasets, and release 1.07M pointwise scores, rubric-level dimension scores, and prompt templates. C2. We decompose score variance across judge, strategy, language, and resource tier, showing that judge identity explains more variance than prompting strategy and that the judge × \times strategy interaction exceeds the strategy main effect. C3. We show that target-language prompting produces effects of opposing direction across judges on fixed content and that judge-averaged reporting conceals these differences. C4. We evaluate agreement with human judgements on SSA-MTE, SummEval, and WMT MQM, where Role Prompting attains the highest aggregate correlation ( ρ = 0.483 \rho=0.483 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Zheng et al. (2023) established that capable LLM judges reach agreement with human annotators comparable to inter-annotator agreement on open-ended generation, motivating LLM-as-a-judge as a substitute for reference-based metrics ( Papineni et al., 2002 ; Lin, 2004 ; Sellam et al., 2020 ; Rei et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent work has shifted from validating the paradigm to characterising its failure modes: task complexity, reference quality, and prompt design all affect judge reliability ( Gu et al., 2024b ) , and judge decisions are sensitive to the order in which candidates are presented even when their quality is unchanged ( Shi et al., 2024 ) . In multilingual settings, Fu and Liu (2025a) evaluate five judges across 25 languages and report a mean Fleiss’ κ \kappa of approximately 0.3 0.3 , with agreement deteriorating further for low-resource languages regardless of whether the judge was trained for multilingual use; their prompt-related analysis, however, is confined to a single judge (GPT-4o) and does not compare prompting strategies across architectures. We extend this line by treating judge architecture and prompting strategy as jointly varying factors rather than fixing one to study the other.
blocks.zh: Zheng等人(2023年)规定,有能力的LLM法官与人际注释员就不限成员名额一代达成协议,鼓励LLM-as-a-judge替代基于参考的衡量标准(Papineni等人,2002年;Lin,2004年;Sellam等人,2020年;Rei等人,2020年)。 随后的作品从验证范式转向描述其失败模式:任务复杂,参考质量,以及即时设计均会影响法官的可靠性(Gu等,2024b),而即使候选人的质量不变,法官的裁决也会对候选人的呈现顺序敏感(Shi等,2024). 在多语种环境下,傅和刘(2025a)对25种语言的5名法官进行了评价,并报告Fleiss的约0.3克帕的平均比率,无论法官是否受过多语种使用培训,对低资源语言的协议都进一步恶化;然而,他们的即时分析仅限于一名法官(GPT-4o),没有比较各个架构的迅速战略。 我们通过将法官架构和推动战略视为共同的不同因素,而不是确定一个因素来研究另一个因素,来扩大这一条线。

blocks.en: Few-shot exemplars ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , chain-of-thought reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , and self-consistency decoding ( Wang et al., 2023 ) were developed for task-solving and later adapted to judging: rubric-conditioned scoring ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , persona conditioning ( Salewski et al., 2023 ) , and translate-then-evaluate pipelines ( Fernandes et al., 2023 ) are now common judge configurations, alongside calibration-example prompting for translation quality estimation ( Kocmi and Federmann, 2023 ) . Bellibatlu et al. (2026) introduce the Judge Sensitivity Score to quantify how often a judge changes its decision under semantically equivalent rephrasing, evaluating 13 judges across four tasks and finding that model scale does not predict stability; their study, like the prompting literature it builds on, is English-only, leaving open whether prompt sensitivity itself is language-dependent. Sclar et al. (2024) report a related finding for task-solving LLMs, that formatting perturbations of a fixed prompt shift performance substantially, again in English. We adapt the comparative logic of these studies, holding content fixed and varying the prompt to a multilingual, multi-judge setting.
blocks.zh: 少许镜头示例 (Brown等,2020年),"思想的连锁推理"(Wei等,2022年),"自相矛盾解码"(Wang等,2023年)是为解决任务而开发的,后被改编为判断: 卢氏条件分(Kim等,2024年),人格调节(Salewski等,2023年),并被翻译为当时评价的管道. (Fernandes等, 2023年)现在是常见的法官配置, Bellibatlu等(2026年)引入了"敏锐评分"法官,以量化一名法官在模拟等同重写下改变其裁决的频率,评价了13名法官跨越了4个任务,并发现模型尺度不能预测稳定性;他们的研究,同它所借鉴的提示性文献一样,是仅以英语为主的,对于即时敏感本身是否依赖语言,留下了开朗. Sclar等人(2024年)报告了一项解决任务LLMs的相关结论,即对固定即时班次性能的扰动进行实质性格式化,同样使用英文。 我们调整了这些研究的比较逻辑,把内容固定下来,并改变迅速性,使之适应多种语言、多法官的环境。

blocks.en: Benchmark infrastructure for low-resource languages has expanded through Masakhane ( Nekoto et al., 2020 ) , FLORES-200 ( NLLB Team et al., 2022 ) , and MAFAND-MT ( Adelani et al., 2022 ) , yet models continue to underperform on typologically diverse and low-resource languages independent of training-data volume ( Teklehaymanot et al., 2026 ) , and cross-lingual transfer remains contingent on linguistic similarity ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) . Within LLM-as-a-judge specifically, Chung and Freienthal (2026) generate synthetic dialogues under matched conditions across three Finno-Ugric languages and find that surface-level dimensions (grammar, fluency) are stable across languages while higher-level judgments (coherence) are not, indicating that some cross-lingual instability originates in the evaluation process itself rather than in the content evaluated. Chang et al. (2025) show that judge–human alignment declines as resource level falls, consistent with Fu and Liu ’s findings. MM-Eval ( Son et al., 2024 ) and M-Prometheus ( Pombal et al., 2025 ) extend meta-evaluation and judge training to more languages, respectively, but both fix the prompting protocol; neither varies it as a factor. No existing study crosses prompting strategy with judge architecture and language resource level simultaneously, which is the gap we address.
blocks.zh: 低资源语言的基准基础设施通过Masakhane(Nekoto等,2020年),FLORES-200(NLLB)得到了扩大。 Team等人,2022年)和MAFAND-MT (Adelani等人,2022年),然而模型在类型多样性和低资源语言上的表现仍然不足,独立于培训-数据量(Teklehaymanot等人,2026年),跨语言转移仍然取决于语言的相似性(Quu等人,2024年). 具体地说,在LLM-as-a-judge中,Chung和Freienthal(2026年)在三种芬诺-乌戈尔语的相匹配条件下进行合成对话,并发现表层维度(语法、流利)在各语言之间是稳定的,而更高层次的判断(一致性)则不是,这表明一些跨语言不稳定源于评价过程本身,而不是评价的内容。 Chang等人(2025年)表明,法官-人际关系随着资源水平的下降而下降,这与傅和刘的调查结果是一致的。 MM-Eval(Son等,2024年)和M-Prometheus(Pombal等,2025年)分别将元评分和评分培训扩展到了更多的语言,但两者都固定了提示协议;两者都不作为因素而有所区别. 现有研究没有一项能同时与法官结构和语言资源水平交叉推动战略,而这正是我们处理的差距。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设计

blocks.en: We examine the effects of prompting strategy and judge model on multilingual pointwise evaluation. The benchmark comprises four open-weight judges, nine prompting strategies, 27 languages, four tasks, and 13 datasets. Each observation is a score assigned to a candidate output by one judge under one prompting strategy.
blocks.zh: 我们审查促进战略和判断模式对多语种点评的影响。 基准包括4名开放量级法官、9项激励战略、27种语言、4项任务和13个数据集。 每项观察均是一名法官根据一项促动战略分配给候选人产出的分数。

blocks.en: All applicable judge–strategy configurations receive the same source input, candidate output, and task-specific rubric. Except for SSA-MTE, the candidate outputs are human-written references. We separately evaluate alignment with human quality judgements using system outputs from SSA-MTE, SummEval, and WMT MQM.
blocks.zh: 所有适用的法官-战略配置都得到相同的源输入、候选产出和任务特定标题。 除SSA-MTE外,候选产出均为人文参考. 我们利用SSA-MTE、SummEval和WPT MQM的系统产出,分别评估与人类质量判断的一致性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Prompting Strategies
blocks.zh: 3.3 迅速战略

blocks.en: We evaluate nine prompting strategies spanning calibration examples, explicit reasoning, evaluator roles, and prompt language. All strategies use the same task-specific rubric and five-point scoring scale. Table 2 reports their task applicability.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了九项激励战略,涉及校准实例、明确的推理、评估作用和迅速的语言。 所有策略都使用相同的任务特有标题和五分分分级. 表2报告了它们的任务适用性。

blocks.en: Table 2: Prompting strategies and task applicability.
blocks.zh: 表2:推动战略和任务适用性。

blocks.en: Zero-shot provides the evaluation instruction, rubric, score definitions, and instance without demonstrations. Few-shot anchored adds high- and low-quality calibration examples ( Fernandes et al., 2023 ; Kocmi and Federmann, 2023 ) . Prometheus-style prompting elicits criterion-level assessments before the holistic score ( Kim et al., 2024 ) . Chain-of-Thought requests an explicit stepwise assessment before scoring ( Wei et al., 2022 ) . Role prompting assigns a task- and language-specific evaluator role ( Salewski et al., 2023 ) . Self-consistency samples three Chain-of-Thought evaluations and aggregates their holistic scores ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 0-shot提供评价指导,标题,分数定义,以及没有演示的例子. 少发弹锚能增加高质量和低质量的校正实例(Fernandes等,2023;Kocmi和Federmann,2023.). 普罗米修斯式的催化在整体分数(Kim等人,2024年)之前即引起标准级别的评估. 思考链要求在评分前进行明确的分步评估(Wei等人,2022年)。 促使发挥作用的作用是指定一个任务和具体语言的评价者角色(Salewski等人,2023年)。 自相容性抽样三条"思链"评价并汇总其整体分数(王等,2023).

blocks.en: Cross-Lingual prompting uses English instructions to evaluate target-language candidates ( Ahuja et al., 2023 ) . Monolingual prompting translates the instructions, rubric, and score definitions into the candidate language. Trans-Eval first translates the candidate into English and then evaluates the translated output ( Fernandes et al., 2023 ) . Appendix C provides the complete prompt templates.
blocks.zh: 交叉语言提示使用英语指示来评价目标语言候选人 (Ahuja等,2023年). 单语言提示将指令,标题,分数定义翻译为候选语言. Trans-Eval首先将候选人翻译成英语,然后评价被翻译的产出(Fernandes等,2023.). 附 录 C提供了完整的即时模板.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价议定书

blocks.en: Each judge assigns task-specific criterion scores and a holistic score from 1 to 5, with higher scores indicating better quality. We use the holistic score for cross-task analyses and the criterion scores for task-specific analyses. Table 3 summarises the criteria.
blocks.zh: 每位法官分配具体任务的标准分和1至5分的整体分数,较高分数显示质量更好. 我们把整体分数用于跨任务分析,把标准分数用于特定任务分析. 表3概述了标准。

blocks.en: Table 3: Task-specific evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 表3:特定任务评价标准。

blocks.en: For XQuAD, PersianQA, CatalanQA, and Belebele, passage grounding measures whether the answer is supported by the supplied passage. AfriQA provides no passage, so its rubric contains only relevance and completeness. For mathematical reasoning, judges assess the final answer, validity of the derivation, and completeness of the solution.
blocks.zh: 对于QXQuAD,波斯QA,加泰罗尼亚QA,和Belebele,通过度量,确定答案是否得到所提供通道的支持. AfriQA不提供通道,因此其标题只包含相关性和完整性. 对于数学推理,法官评估最终答案,推论的有效性,以及解决方案的完整性.

blocks.en: We evaluate human-score alignment on SSA-MTE ( Li et al., 2025b ) , SummEval ( Fabbri et al., 2021 ) , and WMT MQM ( Freitag et al., 2021 ) . SSA-MTE contains 12,565 multilingual system translations, SummEval contains 1,600 English summaries, and the WMT MQM subset contains 500 English translations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了SSA-MTE(Li等,2025年b),SummEval(Fabbri等,2021年)和WMT MQM(Freitag等,2021年b)的人类分数一致。 SSA-MTE包含12,565个多语种系统翻译,SummEval包含1,600个英语摘要,而WMT MQM子集包含500个英语翻译.

blocks.en: 3.5 Judge Models and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.5 法官模式和执行细节

blocks.en: We use four instruction-tuned open-weight judges: Aya Expanse 32B ( Dang et al., 2024 ) , Gemma 3 27B ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , Qwen 2.5 32B, and Qwen 2.5 72B-AWQ ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) .

blocks.en: We run batched inference with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) on NVIDIA A100 and H100 GPUs. All strategies except self-consistency use temperature 0 and top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 . Self-Consistency uses temperature 0.7 and three independently sampled responses. We select the modal holistic score. When all three scores differ, we use their arithmetic mean. We use seed 42 throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们在NVIDIA A100和H100 GPU上对vLLM(Kwon等,2023年)进行了批量推论. 除自相容性外,所有策略均使用温度0和上-p=1.0p=1.0. 自相容性使用温度0.7和三个独立抽样的响应. 我们选择模式整体分数。 当三个分数都不同时 我们用他们的算术平均值 我们一直用42个种子

blocks.en: Each response contains criterion-level scores, a holistic score, and a short justification. We extract numeric scores from the specified response schema. Outputs without a valid holistic score in the interval [ 1 , 5 ] [1,5] are recorded as parsing failures and excluded from score aggregation. The evaluation produced 1,068,528 valid scores.

blocks.en: We find that the effect of a prompting strategy on evaluation scores depends on both the Judge and the target language. Judge dependence is quantified by the Judge × \times strategy interactions, exceeding the strategy’s effect when measured independently. This, however, comes with an exception on Summarization, where we observe that different judges exhibit different preferences w.r.t. the strategies.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated nine prompting strategies across four open-weight judges, 27 languages, and four generation tasks. Prompting effects varied across judges: the judge–strategy interaction exceeded the strategy main effect, judges showed limited agreement on strategy rankings, and target-language prompting produced effects of opposing direction across models. The strategy with the lowest cross-language dispersion also differed from that with the highest aggregate correlation with human judgements, indicating that score stability does not imply evaluation validity. Prompt design should therefore be treated as part of the judge configuration and validated for the intended judge, task, and language. Future work should evaluate additional judge families and system-generated outputs spanning a wider quality range, quantify the effects of prompting on system rankings, and develop prompt-selection methods that improve agreement with human judgements across languages.

blocks.zh: 道德考虑。

blocks.en:
Our results should not be read as
grounds for excluding low-resource languages from LLM-as-a-judge
pipelines; rather, they show that judge and strategy choice must be
validated per language before deployment, particularly where
evaluation outcomes affect downstream model selection or content
moderation for these communities. All datasets used are publicly
released for research use, and we release our own scores under the
same principle to support independent verification. Our experiments
consumed substantial GPU compute (Section 3.5 );
we mitigate this by releasing all 1.07M scores so that others can
reuse them without re-running the benchmark.

blocks.en:
Prompt C.1: Zero-Shot Evaluation Prompt [System] You are an evaluator of machine translation quality. Rubric Adequacy, Fluency, Terminology — full criteria. [User] Evaluate the quality of the following machine translation. Source text (English) ‘‘We now have 4-month-old mice...’’ Reference translation (Swahili) ‘‘Sasa tuna panya...’’ Model translation {TEXT TO EVALUATE} Score each rubric dimension, then provide an overall score
from 1 to 5 followed by a brief justification.

Express C.1:0-Shot评价快取 [系统]. 你是机器翻译质量的评估者 Rubric Adency, Fluency,术语——完全标准. [用户] 评估下列机器翻译的质量。 来源文本(英文) :"我们现在有4个月大的老鼠..." 参考翻译(斯瓦希里语) 模型翻译 {TEXT to EVALUATE} 每个分数的分数,然后提供总分数

three times with a sampling temperature of 0.7 0.7 . blocks.en: Appendix L Use of generative AI
blocks.zh: 附 录 L

blocks.en: Generative AI tools were used at several stages during the preparation of this study. GitHub Copilot and Claude Code were used as coding assistants during the development of the evaluation pipeline and for debugging. Additionally, LLMs (Grammarly and Claude) were used to support the writing process, specifically for correcting spelling and grammatical inconsistencies, improving clarity, and reducing selected sections to comply with space constraints. Furthermore, all aspects of the research design, methodology, analysis, and conclusions presented in this study are the independent work of the author.
